ownership.quote: Apoxy is the programmable edge platform that simplifies connectivity, security, and custom logic deployment for distributed applications.

stage.note: Confirmed as a YC S23 (Summer 2023) company on the YC-listed apoxy.dev domain, which implies at least a YC accelerator investment, but no press release, TechCrunch/Crunchbase/aggregator page, or company statement disclosing a priced round, amount, or lead investor could be found (search engines were dominated by unrelated 'epoxy' results and Crunchbase/LinkedIn pages were blocked/authwalled). Stage left unknown rather than guessed.

note: Apoxy (YC S23, ycdc_status 'Active') is the same company as the pricing/feature card at apoxy.dev - confirmed by matching website URL (https://apoxy.dev) on the YC company page. Founder identified via YC/HN: Dmitry Ilyevsky (technical co-founder, ex-Render/Mux/Cruise/Google/Motorola). The product has since expanded from an edge/proxy platform to include 'CLRK', an open-source gVisor-based agent runtime. No funding round amount, stage beyond YC participation, or revenue figures were found in ~15 minutes of searching (web search results were heavily polluted by unrelated 'epoxy resin' products, and Crunchbase/LinkedIn blocked automated access).
